```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source("scripts/report-helpers.R")
report <- prepare_catch_report(params)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "NA")
```

## `r params$doc_title`

`r params$authors`

`r if (params$example) "**EXAMPLE ONLY — synthetic data; unsuitable for management advice.**" else ""`

The most recent full assessment of this stock was in `r params$last_full_year`
and can be found in the [Council SAFE report library](https://www.npfmc.org/library/safe-reports/).
Catch data are current through `r params$catch_data_date`.
The supplied assessment schedule identifies `r params$next_full_year` as the next full assessment year.
The table presents the supplied specifications through `r params$year + 2`;
the report performs no assessment or projection calculations.

## Catch and specifications

OFL (overfishing limit), ABC (acceptable biological catch), TAC (total allowable
catch), and catch are in metric tonnes (t). Values and row order are retained
from the snapshot for `r params$year - 1`–`r params$year + 2`.
NA means missing or unavailable in the snapshot; zero remains zero.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-catch
#| tbl-cap: "Catch and specifications from the supplied snapshot (t)."
knitr::kable(report$table, digits = 10, format.args = list(scientific = FALSE))
```

## Data provenance

Source: `r params$input_source`.
Snapshot date: `r params$snapshot_date`.
Input file: `r basename(params$input_csv)`.
Input MD5: `r report$input_md5`.
Selection: `r params$stock`, `r params$area`, report year `r params$year`.

Production use requires an approved snapshot, confirmation of the assessment
schedule and units, and author review of the values and narrative.
